summary: BinaryQuantized vector len() counted stored machine words instead of decoded elements. Each word yields QUANTIZED_WORD_SIZE elements, including padding, so the fix multiplies the word count by that constant. On a 64-bit target, the regression test added by the fix expects 64 for its one-word vector; reversing only this calculation returns 1. The regions are exact and unique in their respective Git revisions. No tests were executed.
expected_failure: Snapshot assertion for unaligned.len() fails: expected "64", actual "1".
